#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

class CF1187G {
public:
    CF1187G() {}
    
    class Reader {
    private:
        const static int BUF_SIZE = 1 << 15;
        unsigned char buf[BUF_SIZE];
        int pos, len;
        FILE* stream;
        
    public:
        Reader(FILE* is) : stream(is), pos(0), len(0) {}
        
        int nextByte() {
            if (pos >= len) {
                len = fread(buf, 1, BUF_SIZE, stream);
                pos = 0;
                if (len <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return buf[pos++];
        }
        
        int nextInt() {
            int b;
            while ((b = nextByte()) <= 32) if (b == -1) return -1;
            int n = 0;
            while (b > 32) {
                n = n * 10 + (b - '0');
                b = nextByte();
            }
            return n;
        }
    };
    
    static const int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    vector<vector<int>> adjList;
    int nodeCount, edgeCount;
    vector<int> pi, d, prevNode;
    vector<int> u, v, uv, c;
    vector<int> cap;
    
    void setup(int nodes, int edges) {
        adjList.resize(nodes);
        for (int i = 0; i < nodes; i++) adjList[i].clear();
        pi.assign(nodes, INF);
        d.assign(nodes, 0);
        prevNode.assign(nodes, 0);
        u.assign(edges, 0);
        v.assign(edges, 0);
        uv.assign(edges, 0);
        c.assign(edges, 0);
        cap.assign(edges * 2, 0);
        edgeCount = 0;
    }
    
    void connect(int from, int to, int capacity, int cost) {
        int idx = edgeCount++;
        u[idx] = from;
        v[idx] = to;
        uv[idx] = from ^ to;
        c[idx] = cost;
        cap[idx * 2] = capacity;
        adjList[from].push_back(idx * 2);
        adjList[to].push_back(idx * 2 + 1);
    }
    
    vector<int> q;
    int qHead, qTail, qLen;
    vector<bool> inQ;
    
    void enqueue(int x) {
        if (inQ[x]) return;
        if (qHead + qTail == (int)q.size()) {
            if (qLen * 2 <= (int)q.size()) {
                for (int i = 0; i < qLen; i++) {
                    q[i] = q[qHead + i];
                }
            } else {
                vector<int> nq(q.size() * 2);
                for (int i = 0; i < qLen; i++) {
                    nq[i] = q[qHead + i];
                }
                q = nq;
            }
            qHead = 0;
        }
        q[qHead + qTail++] = x;
        inQ[x] = true;
    }
    
    int dequeue() {
        int x = q[qHead++];
        qLen--;
        inQ[x] = false;
        return x;
    }
    
    bool findShortestPath(int src, int dst) {
        fill(pi.begin(), pi.end(), INF);
        pi[src] = 0;
        fill(d.begin(), d.end(), 0);
        qHead = qTail = 0;
        enqueue(src);
        
        while (qLen > 0) {
            int cur = dequeue();
            int nd = d[cur] + 1;
            
            for (int e : adjList[cur]) {
                if (cap[e] > 0) {
                    int idx = e >> 1;
                    int cost = (e & 1) == 0 ? c[idx] : -c[idx];
                    int np = pi[cur] + cost;
                    int to = cur ^ uv[idx];
                    
                    if (pi[to] > np || (pi[to] == np && d[to] > nd)) {
                        pi[to] = np;
                        d[to] = nd;
                        prevNode[to] = e;
                        enqueue(to);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return pi[dst] != INF;
    }
    
    void augmentUnit(int src, int dst) {
        for (int node = dst; node != src; node ^= uv[prevNode[node] >> 1]) {
            int e = prevNode[node];
            cap[e]--;
            cap[e ^ 1]++;
        }
    }
    
    int computeMinCostFlow(int src, int dst) {
        while (findShortestPath(src, dst)) {
            augmentUnit(src, dst);
        }
        int total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < edgeCount; i++) {
            total += c[i] * cap[i * 2 + 1];
        }
        return total;
    }
    
    void solve() {
        Reader rd(stdin);
        int n = rd.nextInt();
        int m = rd.nextInt();
        int k = rd.nextInt();
        int c_val = rd.nextInt();
        int d_val = rd.nextInt();
        
        vector<int> special(k);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            special[i] = rd.nextInt() - 1;
        }
        
        vector<vector<int>> g(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) g[i].clear();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int a = rd.nextInt() - 1;
            int b = rd.nextInt() - 1;
            g[a].push_back(b);
            g[b].push_back(a);
        }
        
        int T = k + 1;
        int totalNodes = n * T + 1;
        int totalEdges = k + (m * 2 * k + n) * (T - 1);
        
        setup(totalNodes, totalEdges);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < T - 1; t++) {
                int u_node = i * T + t;
                for (int w : g[i]) {
                    int v_node = w * T + t + 1;
                    for (int x = 1; x <= k; x++) {
                        connect(u_node, v_node, 1, c_val + (x * 2 - 1) * d_val);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < T - 1; t++) {
                int u_node = i * T + t;
                int v_node = u_node + 1;
                connect(u_node, v_node, k, i == 0 ? 0 : c_val);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            connect(totalNodes - 1, special[i] * T, 1, 0);
        }
        
        cout << computeMinCostFlow(totalNodes - 1, 0 * T + T - 1) << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    CF1187G solver;
    solver.solve();
    return 0;
}
